name: NCAA D-I South Central Regional Cross Country Championships
where: College Station, TX · host Texas A&M
headline: NCAA D-I South Central Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Men: No. 7 Arkansas and No. 25 Tulane. Women: No. 23 Arkansas. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21. · Women 6K 9:00 a.m. CT · Men 10K 10:00 a.m. CT
